name: Outlines
one_liner: Constrains generation so output matches a schema.
what_it_is: A library its documentation describes as guaranteeing structured outputs during generation, and as low-abstraction. Rather than validating after the fact, it constrains what the model may emit while it is emitting, so tokens that would break the structure are not available to sample.
why_it_matters: Constraining generation rather than checking it afterwards removes the retry loop entirely, which changes the cost profile for schema-heavy work. It needs access to the sampling step, so it applies where you run the model — not to a hosted API you can only send requests to.
suitable_for: Self-hosted models where sampling can be constrained
Grammars and formats stricter than JSON
Workloads where retry cost from invalid output is the bottleneck
not_suitable_for: Hosted APIs that expose no sampling control
Teams wanting a high-level abstraction rather than a low-level one
Cases where post-hoc validation is sufficient and simpler
